author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-k48: ComBat PCA(64) Embedding + Residualized-PC BalancedGraph (k=48)
abstract: Dual-source variant with k=48. Embedding via ComBat-corrected PCA (64 PCs on HVGs); Graph via residualized PCs (γ=0.75, l2=1e-3) and batch-balanced cosine kNN (k=48, binary). Goal: test if slightly higher degree improves composite beyond k=45 (0.7118).
